title: Sunflower surprise
scene: Low view upward past a tall sunflower to ROB tilting his head and lifting a lantern beside its petals; Puppy behind one broad leaf.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE original finished portrait children's coloring-book illustration, not a montage. Black bold smooth outlines on pure white paper; no color, gray, shading, hatching, microtexture, text, letters, numbers or border. Preschool ages 3-5: large easy-to-color closed spaces, broad shapes, expressive animation-quality drawing. Puppy is a small floppy-eared dog with plain collar. Include only characters named in the scene, never add ROB when it says no robot. Draw specifically the described action and viewpoint with natural interaction, not stock standing front view. Coherent scene, 4-6 main elements, big shapes and broad outlines. Fill most of portrait 2:3 page while keeping white margin. SCENE: Low view upward past a tall sunflower to ROB tilting his head and lifting a lantern beside its petals; Puppy behind one broad leaf.
